You are a programming expert. 
        You will be provided with a patch used to fix a bug. 
        Based on the commit message and modifications in the patch, you need to analyze the root cause of the bug in detail. 

        Here is the patch content:
        From ebef05e999309fb13f4d557f343ec22345d9eade Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Valery Yatsynovich <valery_yatsynovich@epam.com>
Date: Wed, 5 Feb 2020 12:10:54 +0300
Subject: [PATCH] Fix NPE when stories are run using JUnit runner (#297)

jbehave-junit-runner builds JUnit execution tree before the actual
execution. Also it knows nothing about Vividus batches. As result
when BDD stories are run NPE is thrown, because no batch is running.
This is a fix for regression bug introduced in e083434 (see
EmbedderControlsProvider.getDefault()).
---
 .../main/java/org/vividus/bdd/context/BddRunContext.java    | 3 ++-
 .../java/org/vividus/bdd/context/BddRunContextTests.java    | 6 ++++++
 2 files changed, 8 insertions(+), 1 deletion(-)

diff --git a/vividus-bdd-engine/src/main/java/org/vividus/bdd/context/BddRunContext.java b/vividus-bdd-engine/src/main/java/org/vividus/bdd/context/BddRunContext.java
index 86c5d4ed1..232d0fac5 100644
--- a/vividus-bdd-engine/src/main/java/org/vividus/bdd/context/BddRunContext.java
+++ b/vividus-bdd-engine/src/main/java/org/vividus/bdd/context/BddRunContext.java
@@ -29,7 +29,8 @@ public class BddRunContext implements IBddRunContext
 {
     private TestContext testContext;
 
-    private Optional<String> runningBatchKey;
+    // must be initialized for jbehave-junit-runner
+    private Optional<String> runningBatchKey = Optional.of("batch-1");
     private boolean dryRun;
 
     public void putRunningStory(RunningStory story, boolean givenStory)
diff --git a/vividus-bdd-engine/src/test/java/org/vividus/bdd/context/BddRunContextTests.java b/vividus-bdd-engine/src/test/java/org/vividus/bdd/context/BddRunContextTests.java
index adf0f6a48..6cb570d7d 100644
--- a/vividus-bdd-engine/src/test/java/org/vividus/bdd/context/BddRunContextTests.java
+++ b/vividus-bdd-engine/src/test/java/org/vividus/bdd/context/BddRunContextTests.java
@@ -83,6 +83,12 @@ class BddRunContextTests
         assertNull(bddRunContext.getRunningStory());
     }
 
+    @Test
+    void testGetDefaultRunningBatchKey()
+    {
+        assertEquals("batch-1", bddRunContext.getRunningBatchKey());
+    }
+
     @Test
     void testGetRunningBatchKey()
     {
-- 
2.25.1


        
        Provide a response strictly in the following format:
        Root cause:<Root cause>

Root cause: The root cause of the bug was a NullPointerException (NPE) occurring when the JBehave JUnit runner was executed because it did not initialize the `runningBatchKey` variable, which is critical for the BDD execution context. As the execution tree was being built, the absence of an initialized `runningBatchKey` led to a scenario where no batch was running, causing the NPE. The fix involved initializing `runningBatchKey` with a default value to prevent this exception during the execution of BDD stories.

Root cause:
The root cause of the bug was a NullPointerException (NPE) occurring when the JBehave JUnit runner was executed because it did not initialize the `runningBatchKey` variable, which is critical for the BDD execution context. As the execution tree was being built, the absence of an initialized `runningBatchKey` led to a scenario where no batch was running, causing the NPE. The fix involved initializing `runningBatchKey` with a default value to prevent this exception during the execution of BDD stories.
